06 / A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Your questions.
Answered.

Have something else in mind?
We’re an email away.

What can QIXARC build for me?

We work on portfolios, business websites, e-commerce stores, dynamic web applications, UI/UX design, and smart digital systems. Tell us what you want to achieve and we’ll help define the right solution.

How much will my project cost?

Our main service starting prices are listed above. Your final quote depends on pages, features, integrations, and the level of customization. You can also explore the detailed calculator on our current website.

How long does a project take?

Timing depends on the scope, content readiness, and technical requirements. We’ll discuss milestones and agree on a timeline when we review your brief.

Can you redesign an existing website?

Yes. Share your current website and what you’d like to improve. We can explore the design, user experience, and functionality together.

Can I see examples before we begin?

Absolutely. Explore our lineup in the Products section, then tell us what you have in mind for your project.

How do we get started?

Use the project enquiry below, email qixarc@gmail.com, or call +91 83007 15081. A short description of your idea, preferred timeline, and budget is a great place to start.
